limitations: Marker-conditioned proposal locations; not an independent object detector
Full-frame view may contain several categories; prompt rank is not localization
Relative prompt softmax is not probability of category correctness
No human labels or model admission; no change to live semantic observations

prompts.background: a wall or floor without a visible chair, doorway or entrance
prompts.chair: a chair with a seat, backrest and legs in an indoor corridor
prompts.doorway: an open doorway with a door frame leading into a room
prompts.laboratory_entrance: a laboratory entrance with a LAB sign above the opening
prompts.office_entrance: an office entrance with an OFFICE sign above the opening
prompts.sign: a sign or coloured panel on a wall without a visible entrance
